Describe a Maxima calculation and its outputs

Source: R/MaximaVariables.R
maxima_variables.Rd

Creates a MaximaVariables object for an assessment item's template list. With explicit types, this function stores the program without executing it. Without types, it runs the program locally to inspect the returned outputs. The exported XML uses OPAL/ONYX MAXIMA operators; validation requires the extended rqti schema. In rqti Rmd files, use a {maxima} chunk. Output types are inferred from one local execution unless a named variables vector is supplied. Its code is checked locally before item creation, including declared names/types.

Usage

maxima_variables(code, variables = NULL, identifier = "all")

Arguments

code

A single non-empty string containing the Maxima program. It must return a string representation of associations for the named outputs.

variables

A non-empty named character vector of QTI output types: integer, float, or string. Names start with an ASCII letter and contain only ASCII letters, digits, or underscores. All outputs have single cardinality. If omitted, the code is executed locally and types are detected from one returned association list. Explicit types can be used for outputs whose type varies across random variants or for string display of lists.

identifier

The QTI identifier for the intermediate string result. Defaults to "all". Use distinct identifiers for multiple blocks.

Value

A MaximaVariables object.

See also

template_value(), numericGap(), entry()

Examples

calculation <- maxima_variables(
    code = "block([a,b,c], a: random(100), b: random(100),
             c: a + b, string(['a = a, 'b = b, 'c = c]));",
    variables = c(a = "integer", b = "integer", c = "integer")
)
item <- entry(
    identifier = "addition",
    template = list(calculation),
    content = list("<p>", template_value("a"), " + ", template_value("b"),
                   " = ", numericGap(solution_variable = "c"), "</p>")
)
createTemplateDeclaration(item)
#> <templateDeclaration identifier="all" cardinality="single" baseType="string"></templateDeclaration>
#> <templateDeclaration identifier="a" cardinality="single" baseType="integer"></templateDeclaration>
#> <templateDeclaration identifier="b" cardinality="single" baseType="integer"></templateDeclaration>
#> <templateDeclaration identifier="c" cardinality="single" baseType="integer"></templateDeclaration>
createTemplateProcessing(item)
#> <templateProcessing>
#>   <setTemplateValue identifier="all">
#>     <customOperator definition="MAXIMA" value="block([a,b,c], a: random(100), b: random(100),&amp;#xA;&amp;#xD;             c: a + b, string([&amp;#x27;a = a, &amp;#x27;b = b, &amp;#x27;c = c]));"></customOperator>
#>   </setTemplateValue>
#>   <setTemplateValue identifier="a">
#>     <customOperator definition="MAXIMA" value="assoc(a,$(1));">
#>       <variable identifier="all"></variable>
#>     </customOperator>
#>   </setTemplateValue>
#>   <setTemplateValue identifier="b">
#>     <customOperator definition="MAXIMA" value="assoc(b,$(1));">
#>       <variable identifier="all"></variable>
#>     </customOperator>
#>   </setTemplateValue>
#>   <setTemplateValue identifier="c">
#>     <customOperator definition="MAXIMA" value="assoc(c,$(1));">
#>       <variable identifier="all"></variable>
#>     </customOperator>
#>   </setTemplateValue>
#>   <setCorrectResponse identifier="id_gap_9686">
#>     <variable identifier="c"></variable>
#>   </setCorrectResponse>
#> </templateProcessing>
createItemBody(item)
#> <itemBody>
#>   <div>
#>     <p>
#>     <printedVariable identifier="a"></printedVariable>
#>      + 
#>     <printedVariable identifier="b"></printedVariable>
#>      = 
#>     <textEntryInteraction responseIdentifier="id_gap_9686" expectedLength="10" placeholderText=""></textEntryInteraction>
#>     </p>
#>   </div>
#> </itemBody>
